clean_description: Anathem follows Fraa Erasmas, a young avout living in a secluded community dedicated to mathematics and philosophy, as he prepares for a rare event called Apert. This celebration allows the avout to venture into the outside world, which has been marked by historical violence against their community. As Erasmas reconnects with his past, he faces unforeseen challenges that threaten both his cloistered life and the broader world, leading him to play a crucial role in averting global disaster.
setting: alternate world with a focus on mathematics and philosophy
